summary: Client requests help after receiving immigration court paperwork about an alleged overstay. She provided a Notice to Appear and a Notice of Hearing. The hearing notice lists December 15, 2026, at 9:00 a.m. Eastern Time. Documents are on file for review.

Client requests help understanding a USCIS receipt notice for his work-permit application. He also provided a Maryland reckless-driving citation and trial notice. The trial notice lists December 15, 2026, at 9:00 a.m. Eastern Time. Client reports that he has diabetes and experienced sudden confusion around the time of the driving incident. He disputes the officer’s account and says medical records and glucose-monitor data may be available. Those records have not been provided. Documents and client statements are ready for review.
